title: strcpy into 32-byte slot->label without length check in aurora_profile_label()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/profile_label.c:L29 calls strcpy(slot->label, label) where slot->label is a 32-byte field and label arrives from an HTTP POST request body via the CGO boundary in aurora-compute/api/profile.go:L32; a label string longer than 31 bytes overflows the struct field. The scanner rule fired as CWE-676 but the actual defect is CWE-121.
